material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Mar 23 to Aug 10 (+30%; wave 3 is 1.9 times wave 1). material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.
